summary: This Form 6-K filed by MKDWELL Tech Inc. (Nasdaq: MKDW) reports the issuance of 709,740 new ordinary shares to four individuals under the company’s 2026 Equity Incentive Plan, which was registered on Form S-8. The issuance does not involve a change of control, merger, tender offer, or any special-situation transaction. Following the issuance, the company had 4,258,442 ordinary shares and 274,366 Class A preferred shares outstanding. This is a routine equity grant filing with no special-situation relevance.
